summary:
I wrote the top-level node:test case 'GC03 real owner allowed denied cold tamper' at the end of build_tenants/abiogenesis/typescript/test_env/tests/t287-governed-context.test.mjs and ran it four times. It has not passed: every run failed during installed setup, before any Run, Testing or Construction call happened. No product source was changed (no fix was attempted) and the support module was not edited. The only other edit in that file adds the imports the new test needs: `cp`, `pathToFileURL` and `packageRoot`.

What the test does: it reuses setupInstalledRootCatalog with a packed artifact, libraryEnvironment, libraryConsumerDeclaration, prepareRegisteredSelectionProduct, witnessInput, constructInstalledStartCall and runInstalledCliRequest. It regenerates its policy, activation template and dependency pins from the actual adapter and Python bytes in a private temp folder; it does not copy the old B05 pin or read the operator folder. It extends the RunEnvironment with one more dependency and Context holding the policy and template, and binds them to the constructor role. Both private Program keys (`abg.governed_context` and `abg.governed_context.activation`) are added to the consumer Program. The fake provider is a local node script set through ABG_TS_CLAUDE_COMMAND. It picks Testing first, then Construction citing result refs found in its prompt. During the governed Construction it runs the installed fixed client for late/0, late/1 and late/2 plus a denied key late/99. It then emits Claude stream-json output. The planned assertions cover both keys surviving owner admission, a same-Run admitted Testing Result, exact task/rubric/Testing bytes, the denied reply, a cold check from stored bytes, and refusal of tampered output.

Where it failed, in order:
1. Scratch layout: the witness folder is found relative to the repo root, so I mirrored the repo layout inside the scratch folder.
2. Manifest generation refused a symlinked node_modules ('bundled dependency resolves outside its exact package root: @standard-schema/spec'). I replaced the symlink with an APFS clone copy of the pinned toolchain; the toolchain itself was not changed.
3. The real declaration owner refused my RunEnvironment extension ('invalid exact run environment declaration'). An in-memory check showed the extension is valid with one member; I reordered the two members by path and that step then passed.
4. constructDefaultGovernanceLibraryModulePublication needed the publication basis fields (productId, artifactDigest, productContentDigest, productManifestDigest). I supplied them the same way t287-default-library.test.mjs does.
5. Current stopping point, after about 34s: setupInstalledRootCatalog (test_env/support/root-installed-environment.mjs:509) finds no program validation for the root Program and throws 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading kind)'. The live default-library case passes an extra `additionalCorePublicationConstructors` option that this test does not yet pass.

All of these failures were in how the test is set up, not in product code, so no product fix inside the 23-path grant has been identified yet. B05's host-lookup path, admission digest, 8192-byte page refusal and adapter assembly are untouched.

Checks run with the pinned offline toolchain (rc2-dogfood-01, Node v24.7.0):
- The unfiltered TypeScript compile (`node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json`) printed no diagnostics, about 7s. Its exit code was not captured because the shell is zsh, and it ran before the test was added. The test file is .mjs and not part of tsc input.
- Manifest generation exited 0 after the copy fix.
- The named test exited 1 on all four runs; logs are named-run-1.log to named-run-4.log in the scratch folder.

Scratch folder, left in place with its logs: /private/var/folders/rz/r6wxvr0n15d906k2s0jw8j2h0000gn/T/abg-b06-gc03.MBgYeZjn. It holds a copy of the package with its build output, the cloned toolchain, a copy of the default-library witness folder and the logs. The test's own temp folders are created under the system temp directory and deleted when the test ends. Nothing was written outside the scratch folder and the declared test file. The input identity for the Construction call is projected inside actor_process.ts; the test makes no claim about a published CCall digest. Nothing is accepted, no C2 was run and no installed witness exists.
gaps: The named test has never passed. It stops in setupInstalledRootCatalog (root-installed-environment.mjs:509) because there is no root Program validation. The likely missing piece is the `additionalCorePublicationConstructors` option the live default-library case passes; the test does not set it yet.

Not yet run at all: the real held-store Run, the deterministic Testing-then-Construction selection, the same-Run admission of the Testing Result, the governed Construction through HoG, the prepared leaf and the native actor, the fixed client, the released GC03 adapter, and the allowed, denied, cold-check and tamper assertions.

The test-local GC03 policy is minimal: schema, id and limits only. It does not reproduce the full recipe in make-gc03-candidate.py (sources, principals, grants, executors, method profile), because that recipe reads the operator's governed-context-sources folder, which the test may not use at run time. Those sources still need to be produced inside the test.
The activation template member is a placeholder ({kind, operation}). The real GC03 context.assemble template still has to be derived test-locally before deriveGc03HostLookup can succeed.
Whether the policy's role and graph-function permission (worksite/native-work@5, taken from NATIVE_WORKSPACE_WORK_IDS) matches the actual Construction call has not been tested end to end.

The fake provider's selector reply shape, the result refs it pulls from the prompt, and the transcript, cold-check and binding event fields it reads are unverified guesses about the real runtime formats.
No product source failure has been exposed yet, so no fix inside the 23-path grant was made.
The TypeScript compile ran before the test was added and its exit code was not captured. It has not been rerun since the test edits, though .mjs test files are not compiled.
No C2 run, no Root inspection of the focused stdout, and no installed RC3 witness. Nothing is accepted.
